notes.title: JC's Mega Holiday
notes.notes: [p]Hi friends, its been a long time, but 1 year on from the last update here we are. A lot of this stuff was meant for release with the Line1 world which was out previously but not announced.[/p][p][/p][h2]Story[/h2][p]The game now has a story(?), with cut-scenes, extra challenges and special worlds to visit. You'll see important events on the new Compass which is at the top. Who is this JC fella anyway? Some retired old skater it seems, we don't know much about him.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42863457/0c14d5f0371fbe9aad855e8509ef52a54f022910.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42863457/611649bbe8385a1c05d394ca67c4450d8219102d.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]Online[/h2][p]There's some new things for online play, server replays, profiles and spectate. Since the base gameplay got changed quite heavily (mainly, how rewinding works), existing highscores have been cleared (sorry). [i]BUT[/i] if you got a top 10 time up until now, you get an exclusive profile badge which will never be given out again; Urban Legend.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42863457/9fa4e37bf8e1536570a2366922ca2d67179877ca.jpg"][/img][/p][p]You can also choose to represent a country in your server profile too.[/p][p][/p][h2]Custom things[/h2][p]Since a couple of the existing playermodels are now [i]actual characters [/i]in the story, there's a new model to use which can be customized with different colours or styles. It's quite simple at the moment but gives you a fair amount to choose. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42863457/7389f158a0b8c59acc1a77e20687320bd90e66bd.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Additionally, if you want to make a simple custom board with some colour changes or a graphic printed onto it, you can find the board bench at JC's wood shop, or in the Center Island once you've unlocked those places.[/p][p][/p][h2]Quick Menu & Other things[/h2][p]Quick Menu: New small menu, (bound to Q on desktop, D-pad left on controllers), has a couple things in it. You can spectate players who are in your world from here, or end challenges, set a waypoint and teleport to it.[/p][p]World menu: The world map now shows some additional information, and you get a preview of the world before you enter it too. Workshop maps are now accessible from here too instead of hidden in the Center Island.[/p][p]Note if you made some workshop maps before: The Blender addon changed many things to do with entities, I made sure all your worlds still work fine in-game, but opening your Blend file with a new addon version might cause issues. Just a warning![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Most tiniest update ever
notes.notes:
[h3]SDK[/h3]
- Added hot-reloading worlds using command: [b]load_world reload[/b]
- Fixed a bug with existing map-making feature 'flip gate exit'
Its obscure; There wasn't any workshop maps using it. Just in case, it works again.

[h3]Future stuff[/h3]
Gonna use this to inform yall that I plan to price the game up by $1-$2 in the future, as I'm working on a content update. If you already own the game you will get it for free. ːdonutFuː

Sometimes streaming development of that DLC [url=https://www.twitch.tv/harry00000000000000000000]live on my Twitch channel[/url], if you're interested (In the evenings, Mountain Time UTC-6).

notes.title: handslide & handplants

notes.title: Patch note - 10th December
notes.notes:
- late flips
- flip trick sound effects

notes.title: The Skaterift Multiplayer Update
notes.notes:
[h2]Online[/h2]
Multiplayer has moved out of beta into the main game. The global server is connectable from the hub world. The gameserver is located in London but you should have an ok time anywhere in Europe or America. Thanks to those who came and tested!

Online changes during beta: 
- added simple chat messages
- friends names show on the map
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42863457/171b8e7f111cc268f657e00d188f39302c56f213.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42863457/245336941eefa15e3a96ed23d60a3e4c20d9c018.png[/img]

[h2]Hub World[/h2]
The world system has been replaced with a hub world which lets you switch characters and boards out without losing your place in the worlds.

[h3]Regions[/h3]
Courses can now be completed in silver or gold (no-rewinds) and count towards the region's total achievement. You can see the regions on the map or in the hub.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42863457/f1feed126ac8af9afd9e69358a4816f00864f3f1.png[/img]

[h2]3 New Characters[/h2]
A few new people join us including legendary old man skate legend John Cockroach.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42863457/4cd504284faf702f28eb15bfce474fbf8b68c2a3.png[/img]

[h1]Minor Changes (/full patch notes)[/h1]
- allow respawn when fallen over instead of only rewinding
- world map now shows current lighting instead of grey
- workshop maps show their preview image before you load them instead of point clouds
- added practice world
- added extra paths to Mt.Zero and Downtown maps
- added stars to skybox shader
- improved stability on hard landings sometimes throwing you off incorrectly
- clamped grind speed glitch
- re-added timing strips to the ui (+ gold segment status)
- can sit down in the walking mode
- removed invalid scores from highscore server
- fixed freecam going wonky sometimes
- added spark particle system for grinding in completed regions

There is a couple new style challenges to test out. The modelling is roughly inspired by Atlanta and Nashville.

Theres a few things you can do here like:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42863457/c56b311acae5c7bc6f7b01787da0f4ddd271f3cc.png[/img]

As well as a bunch of updates to pretty much every system, there is of course some improvements to the original map Mt.Zero Island.

notes.title: Patch notes - 16th April (beta)
notes.notes:
[h2]The following applies to the beta version:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added occlusion effect for player (Thanks: Fnugz)
[*] Added console variable fps_limit <x>. set to 0 to enable vsync, -1 for adaptive vsync.
[*] Added timer texts to gates
[*] Updated interpolation method for physics objects (should look a bit smoother on high framerate monitors)
[/list]
vsync is now disabled by default for Windows
vsync is now enabled by default for Linux to prevent screen tearing, if your compositor has issues with this, set fps_limit to a multiple of your monitors refresh rate.

notes.title: Preview/beta version for new features
notes.notes:
Quite a bit has changed, but since this is not the full update [i]yet[/i], some features from the base game are unavailable in the beta (achievements, lap times). The new and old versions are downloaded side by side and you can pick which one to launch when you start the game.

Some new features include: tricks, proper flips and grinds on any surface not just rails.
You can also switch to third person, seems to help a lot if you get motion sick :)

Theres a couple more things planned for the full release of this update, but for now its here to test out the new physics and stuff. Hope you like the changes

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42863457/20a505981772ef5bd34c330c68a2452e7e2dc22b.png[/img]

notes.title: Small quality things
notes.notes:
- added: controller_deadzone <value>
- various map QA fixes. thank you: JHead
- fixed undefined behavior related graphic bug. thank you: lacyyy
- ragdolls now use an entirely new constraint solver - should look a bit more natural!

notes.title: Boardslides, map revisions and effects
notes.notes:
[h1]New feature: Boardslides[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42863457/17bbaa98158200695d536dede0b750fa6eb66017.png[/img]

If you see a bright yellow rail somewhere, it means you can boardslide it by jumping up to it. You can balance yourself by pushing the control forwards or back.

[h1]Tweaks/Graphics[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added motion blur effect
[*] Water/Sky were improved
[*] Gate rendering fixed glitches
[*] Falling off no longer kills your current run
[*] Physics adjustments (angular dampening reduced)
[*] Added volume slider to menu
[/list]

[h1]Map revisions[/h1]
Some time was spent revising the map. The main changes are listed here but there are various improvements everywhere.

[h2]Megapark[/h2]
The end zones of yellow and red courses were changed to be more well defined and structured compared to how they used to be.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42863457/c97215907ee5044e5bb9dc27b5307525661ed782.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42863457/b8447dcfd090e533c386a38da966177fac343ed3.png[/img]

[h2]Intro section[/h2]
A (very small) but new path down the third island, as well as a small park at the top to practice.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42863457/6c9cc68b6d7811698c059016c46a944b1a0d987c.png[/img]

[h1]Engine changes (boring)[/h1]
[list]
[*] Switched to SDL2 for window/sound management
[*] Added features to map exporter
[*] Improved rigid body interpolation for systems running less than 60fps
[*] Added some more detailed checks for physics objects to reduce ghost edges
[/list]

notes.title: Small fixes for various bits and bobs
notes.notes:
physics: Improved geometry filtering so that player collides correctly with sharp corners
menu: Now shows correct controller you have plugged in if supported: (Deck,Steam,xbox360,xbox1,ps3,ps4,ps5)
menu: Can set the camera FOV (90-135degrees) thanks for suggestion: [i]Artyom Havok[/i]
menu: Map selector. There is still only 1 map currently, though.
controls: Reworked default layout. (may take 10 minutes to get used to, sorry)
controls: Added keyboard+mouse input
controls: Input is rebind-able, however it is in an alpha state. Future update will make it easy to access.
controls: Deadzones added, might not cover all drift but its a start
map: Made Megapark green's big jump a bit easier to complete

misc: Cleaned launch options
